expectations.text: The generated prompt is written in English
expectations.evidence: The prompt is in Portuguese: 'Quero que você refatore o módulo de pagamentos…'

expectations.text: A prompt file is saved (prompts/*.md or prompt.md) and holds only the prompt, with no notes around it
expectations.evidence: prompt.md holds the prompt only. Note: the test instructions told this run to save prompt.md, so this check does not separate the two configurations.

expectations.text: The prompt contains the ownership sentence ('owner and long-term maintainer of this codebase')
expectations.evidence: No ownership sentence. It says 'O código é nosso e você tem liberdade para reestruturar', which presents the code as the user's, not as the model's own.

expectations.text: The prompt tells the model to keep working through ordinary obstacles and not stop early or offer to continue
expectations.evidence: Partly covered: 'Não pare esperando resposta' handles open questions. Nothing tells the model to work through errors, timeouts, or failing tools, and 'prefira um estado parcial consistente' gives it a reason to stop.

expectations.text: The prompt does not ask for live progress updates during the run (the run is unattended)
expectations.evidence: No live updates asked. It asks for a progress file for recovery, which is not a live update.

expectations.text: The prompt names specific actions the model must not take alone (for example push, deploy, migrations) and says what to do in their place since nobody is available
expectations.evidence: 'Não faça push, não abra PR e não faça merge… Não altere o schema, não crie migrations… descreva a proposta no relatório.'

expectations.text: The prompt asks for a final report that a reader who did not watch the run can follow
expectations.evidence: 'Vou ler de manhã, sem lembrar dos detalhes e sem ter acompanhado nada, então ele precisa se sustentar sozinho.'

expectations.text: The prompt states a definition of done that someone can check (for example tests pass, one source of tax calculation)
expectations.evidence: No single 'done' list, but checkable criteria are present: identical values per flow, characterization tests pass, full suite and linter compared with the baseline.

expectations.text: The prompt has no request to show reasoning, no token budget, and no blanket instruction to delegate to subagents
expectations.evidence: Automatic check: no <thinking> request, no token budget, no subagent instruction.

expectations.text: The reply recommends one Fable 5.2 effort level (low, medium, high, xhigh, or max) with a reason
expectations.evidence: The reply never mentions an effort level.

expectations.text: The reply warns the user about the cost or side effects of the ownership sentence (more tokens, unrequested changes, review the full diff)
expectations.evidence: No ownership sentence was used, so no warning about its cost.
